info.title: Solidino Financial Ledger
info.description: Reviewed SRS §§3.3–3.4, 4 and Appendix C. All routes use loopback HTTP and UTF-8 JSON. Query strings and GET request bodies are rejected. A nonempty body requires Content-Type: application/json (optional charset=utf-8), at most 16,384 bytes, exactly one object and only documented fields. Duplicate JSON keys and chunked framing are rejected. Responses carry Cache-Control: no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Unknown paths return 404 route_not_found. An idle request connection closes after 15 seconds without incoming data (5-second test tolerance); this is separate from the five-second cumulative write-lock budget. Example tokens and IDs are synthetic.
